docs.title: Cryptographic Key Management Procedures
docs.key_generation: Keys generated inside AWS KMS HSMs (FIPS 140-2 Level 3); no key material leaves the HSM boundary.
docs.key_distribution: Access granted only via IAM key policies and grants; no key material is exported or shared out of band.
docs.key_storage: Key material stored only in AWS KMS; envelope-encrypted data keys never persisted in plaintext.
docs.key_rotation: Automatic annual rotation enabled on all pci=true CMKs; verified by control PCI-DSS-3.6.1.
docs.key_destruction: Retired keys scheduled for deletion with a 30-day waiting period after confirming no ciphertext depends on them.
